description: Work Permit, services Tier 2 basic-skilled, full October 2026: levy S$600 employer cost; net pay unchanged (no CPF for foreign employees).
source: MOM 'Services sector: Work Permit requirements' (retrieved 2026-09-24, sha256 191030a4…, last updated 16 Sep 2026): Tier 2 basic-skilled $600 monthly / $19.73 daily; the daily rate applies to Work Permit holders who did not work a full calendar month. MOM 'Foreign worker quota and levy requirements': liability from the day the permit is issued. Employer cost only — never deducted.
